question: Which customers spent more than the average amount spent by all customers who placed at least one order?

FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
GROUP BY customers.id
HAVING SUM(orders.quantity * (SELECT price FROM products WHERE products.id = orders.product_id)) > 
       (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (
           SELECT SUM(orders.quantity * (SELECT price FROM products WHERE products.id = orders.product_id)) AS total_spent
           FROM orders
           GROUP BY orders.customer_id
       ) AS avg_subquery)
